5555.title: Skill inspection rejects directory aliases
5555.rootCauseOneLine: Discovery preserves a linked directory as the skill read root, but host file inspection rejects symbolic-link roots.

prReviews.topFinding: Explicit host root resolution targets the demonstrated failure; linked PR code was not run.

5555.proposedFix: Resolve the selected skill root on its owning host under an explicit policy while preserving generic root rejection and relative containment.
5555.caveats: Filesystem reproduction repeated on Linux; installed macOS UI and live HTTP not exercised. Test is embedded inline under public repository policy. Existing PR 5556 prevents a duplicate fix.
